notes: Route: robots.txt (200, permissive) -> /sitemap/index.xml -> /sitemap/post.xml, an index of per-month archive sitemaps /sitemaparchives/post/2026-{9,10}[-N].xml. Fetched the 5 files covering the window (2026-9-1..9-2, 2026-10..10-2), all 200, each <=5000 entries. Entries are sorted strictly DESCENDING by publication time (file-boundary timestamps are consecutive to the second) and each month file contains exactly the posts PUBLISHED that month. Date per URL: (1) /YYYY/MM/DD/ in the URL path if present (28% of urls, verified == page JSON-LD datePublished to the second), else (2) <lastmod> date-part, accepted only if lastmod's month == file month. 58 September entries had lastmod drifted into October (edited posts) and were dropped, since their lastmod would be the edit date, not the publish date. news.xml (Google News) only holds 3 days (10-24..10-26) so it was not usable for this window. Result: 13728 unique URLs, all 31 window days covered (09-30=526, 10-10=434, 10-20=509, min 338 on 10-04). Verified: 0 duplicates, all dates in window, 4 sample re-fetches returned 200 with 2700-7500 text chars and page JSON-LD datePublished exactly equal to the listed date. ~16 requests total, script runs in ~3s.
